description: Future of Luxury media: the canonical web masters (media/) and the editorial decision for each published essay. WordPress is the runtime media system: a master is restored into the essay's featured image by tools/fol-media-restore.php, and WordPress generates its sizes. An essay published with its plate is either an editorial choice (a native photograph exists but the plate is stronger) or has no native source. The plate also appears automatically whenever a featured file is missing. Runtime art direction (opener, homepage, focus) lives in theme/summit/inc/editorial-art.php summit_fol_photo_direction(); the restore tool reports any difference from this file.

surfaces.opener: photo for grade A, plate for grade B and for plate essays
surfaces.archive_and_related: photo where one is restored, otherwise plate
surfaces.homepage: as archive, unless the essay sets home: plate

master_spec: JPEG, sRGB, at most 2400 px wide, never upscaled, native colour (saturation held only where noted in the inventory), no metadata
